_readme: Upload this file to your GitHub repo alongside data.json. These values power the benchmark comparison callouts in the stakeholder dashboard. Update them to reflect your industry or peer data.
_avgSessionDurationSeconds_note: Higher ed national avg ~2:00-2:20 (120-140 sec). Adjust for your sector.
_engagementRatePct_note: Typical higher ed engagement rate ~50%. GA4 engagement = sessions 10s+ or 2+ pageviews.
_seoScoreGood_note: Siteimprove considers 80+ a good SEO score.
_peerAvgSessions_note: Set to the 90-day session count of a comparable peer organization if known. Leave at 0 to hide the comparison. Example: 450000 for a comparable institution.
